profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Interactive Intelligence
profile.summary: Ten years of professional development experience in the design, implementation, testing, and support of enterprise applications using .NET, cross-platform C++, and the web.  I have particular experience working with network protocols, client-server applications, web application frameworks, databases, and embedded systems.  I have a strong ability and openness to learn new concepts, frameworks, techniques, and languages.  I am looking for an opportunity that leverages my technical and interpersonal skills in a fast paced, technology driven environment.
